title: Rater 1 completes the labelling
caption: The first rater's finished screen: all nineteen items reviewed, the sheet exported, and the saved indicator confirming the answers were recorded server-side rather than only in the browser.
verified: Compared value by value with data/labels/labels_rater1.csv. All 19 identical.

title: Rater 2 completes the labelling
caption: The second rater's finished screen, captured on their own account. Their item_16 count of 4, against Rater 1's 0, is the study's single human disagreement and is discussed in §4.7.
verified: Compared value by value with data/labels/labels_rater2.csv. All 19 identical.

title: The labelling design that was rejected
caption: The first interface asked one rater to read an eighty-three-file codebase and produce a single number. It was abandoned and rebuilt so that each screen carries one judgement.

title: The instrument auditing itself
caption: A live audit of this project's own repository: 141 files, 13,136 lines, 86 of them Python. Security 3.14 per kLOC, complexity 3.58, duplication 4.01%, scope drift 19.

title: A live audit of an unrelated project
caption: The same instrument watching kya-rails, a codebase outside the study: 43 files, 4,620 lines. Scope drift reads 0.00, the reading the metric is designed to produce when output matches its specification.

title: A third party runs the instrument
caption: GovSignal, 30 files and 1,923 lines, audited on a different machine and browser from any used in this study. Security 2.26, complexity 4.79, duplication 0.89%, scope drift 4.

title: Downloads to 5 September
caption: 2,500 all-time installations, 880 in the preceding thirty days and 232 in twenty-four hours, from PyPI's public statistics.

title: Downloads to 10 August
caption: 1,600 all-time and 268 in thirty days, four weeks earlier. Read against the September capture, installations rose by roughly nine hundred over the interval.

title: Which versions people install
caption: Share by release over the quarter: 580 downloads of 0.2.0, 464 of 0.3.0, 358 of 0.1.0 and 207 of 0.4.0. Every published version is in active use.

title: The results table before the errata
caption: The original per-condition output, kept as a record of what the analysis produced before it was corrected. Security density reads 42.05 and 43.67 for claude_code and cursor_agent, and Replit's hallucination mean reads 1.00.
verified: Superseded. Erratum 001 corrects the security figures to 9.65 and 5.93; Erratum 002 corrects the hallucination mean to 1.33. Chapter 4 reports the corrected values.

title: The integrity audit
caption: The working session in which the telemetry that contradicted the published security policy, the unused IP capture, and the route detector's false negative were found and removed.

title: Repairing the labelling tool
caption: Diagnosing why captured code was rendering as raw JSON. The cause was a parser splitting source on spaces; the fix is recorded in the commit history.

title: Before a brief is supplied
caption: lcx-enterprise-core-v2 with no specification loaded. Four metrics report; scope drift returns n/a, because there is nothing to measure the code against.
verified: Paired with the capture below. Reproduced as Figure 4.9.

title: After a brief is supplied
caption: The same project four minutes later, twenty-two lines larger, with a specification loaded. Scope drift now reports 6. The other four metrics are unchanged.
verified: Paired with the capture above. Reproduced as Figure 4.9.

title: Installed from PyPI by a third party
caption: A Windows machine belonging to another user installs the published package and reports success. The file tree beside it shows the context discipline described in §5.4: a CLAUDE.md, a context.md and a THE-RULES.md carried alongside the code.
